$comment: Canonical default tier->model map (z.ai). Used when no user override (models.json) or per-agent override (agent-overrides.json) applies. `primary` is the orchestrator model; it is injected into opencode.json top-level `model` ONLY when the resolver runs with --inject-primary (Docker build) — local (setup.sh) deploys omit it so the end user picks the primary at runtime. Explicit choices (--provider/--mix, or models.json/agent-overrides.json `primary`) always inject regardless of the flag. `long-context` shares the same model id as `primary` (1M ctx) but is the designated tier for large-context subagents (autoresearch research/code/ml loops) — subagents never use the `primary` tier directly. Shipped with the repo; do not edit to personalize - create ~/.config/opencode/models.json instead.
